title: Join probe projection alignment and cache reuse
scope: join index probe projection pruning, primary-key probe cache reuse, and join projection regression coverage

summary: Mapped stage join projection columns back to base table columns with a helper that accepts qualified aliases when building right-side probe projections.
Allowed projected primary-key and BTree join probe paths to reuse full rows already present in row_cache before reading and decoding storage bytes.
Kept join probe partial decode rows in the existing RowDecoder full-width sparse layout so later schema-based projection reads the correct right-side column slots.
Added regressions for projected right columns after the join key and for projected join probes reusing a cached full right row.
